item.title: Insurance penetration in Kenya
item.description: Outlook: Unlike its close cousin, banking, insurance industry in Kenya still has a relatively low market penetration rate. As of 2023, Kenya’s insurance penetration rate stood at 2.3%, according to data by KNBS. Though ahead of its East African neighbors, Kenya still lags behind the regional leader, South Africa, which boasts of an insurance penetration rate of about 10%.
